config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licence/register entry, stating the licence holder label, optional ABN or ACN, licence issue date, principal business address components, and licence conditions

fields.evidence: Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's Australian Business Number (ABN) or Australian Company Number (ACN), with ABN shown if provided.
Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's Australian Business Number (ABN) or Australian Company Number (ACN), with ACN shown if no ABN is provided.
Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality from the current principal business address; blank fields represent addresses that could not be validated.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state from the current principal business address.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode from the current principal business address; August 2026 change log says it is null for addresses outside Australia instead of zero (p.12).
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address; countries outside Australia are set to International.

unmapped_fields.reason: Register classification has no matching ontology target; it is not a legal entity type or status.
AFS licence number is a licence identifier, but this ontology subset has no licence identifier field; it must not be used as an ABN or ACN.
This is the date the AFS licence was issued, not company registration; the ontology has no licence start-date field and explicitly does not support mapping it to entity.date_registered.
Superseded pre-FSR register identifiers and licence numbers have no ontology target; nested values cannot be flattened into the supplied fields.
Current financial services/products authorised under the licence have no matching ontology target; nested condition text is preserved only as source evidence.

limitations: AFS_LIC_NAME is retained as the raw subject label via subject_label_field, but is not asserted as entity.legal_name because the supplied documentation calls it a register entry name and does not establish legal-name status for every record, including individuals.

The combined AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN column is tested independently with checksum-valid ABN and ACN operations; no ACN is inferred from an ABN suffix, and invalid or other-type values emit no identifier observation.

The source is a point-in-time snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensees (Help File p.3); it supplies no entity deregistration/status field, so no entity.status is mapped. Current licence presence does not prove entity activity or registration beyond the source claim.
The source supplies no row-level statement timestamp. The envelope should use the supplied publication timestamp 2026-09-16T21:52:45.982310 as a publication proxy, not as a row-change time.

Principal business address components are mapped where supplied; the documentation states blank values can represent addresses that could not be validated (Help File pp.9-10). Full street address is unavailable.
REGISTER_NAME, AFS_LIC_NUM, AFS_LIC_START_DT, AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR, and AFS_LIC_CONDITION remain unmapped because the ontology has no corresponding licence/register fields.
All authority and field confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
